}}'''Kiyosa Natomo''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the year {{Ne|171}}.

==History==
Kiyosa held the position for twenty-six years until her death in {{Ne|197}}. She was [[Medanor Eramandos]]'s successor and [[Catala Lucanvalle]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Her strength of will and strong personality helped her manage [[White Tower|Tower]] affairs, making her a strong Amyrlin.

Due to her Japanese-inspired name, it is likely that she hailed from the [[Borderlands]].
